title: Youth Ambassador Report on UNICEF Programs in Viet Nam
transcript: Since officially joining the United Nations in 1977, Viet Nam has transformed from a recipient of humanitarian relief into an active partner contributing to global sustainability. Organisations such as UNICEF and UNDP work closely with Vietnamese educational authorities to improve classroom infrastructure, digital literacy, and clean water access in mountainous provinces. In recent years, Vietnamese peacekeepers and technical specialists have successfully participated in international peacekeeping missions and disaster response operations. Furthermore, as an essential member of ASEAN, Viet Nam actively promotes regional economic integration, environmental protection, and cultural exchange among Southeast Asian nations. High school students across the country are encouraged to participate in Model United Nations conferences to develop public speaking, diplomatic negotiation, and cross-cultural communication skills. By engaging in international projects, Vietnamese youth contribute to solving global challenges such as climate change and poverty reduction, while proudly showcasing the rich cultural heritage and hospitality of their homeland to the world.
